open_points.subject: revocation visibility for an in-flight authenticated request
open_points.text: `authorization_guard`: “Immediate” revocation is “every request authenticated after it observes it”; A11/INV-005 and M07 instead say revocation “blocks the next authorization check immediately.”
open_points.question: If a request authenticates before a revocation commits but performs its project-scope authorization check afterward, must that request observe the revocation?
options: Reject it because the next authorization check after commit must observe the revocation.
It may continue because only requests authenticated after the revocation commit are required to observe it.
open_points.default_guess: Reject it at the post-commit authorization check.

witness.initial: An operator has an active session and an active assignment to project P.
events: The operator starts a request for P and its session is authenticated.
An administrator revokes the operator's assignment to P and the revocation commits.
The operator's request proceeds to its project-scope authorization check.
outcomes: The request is rejected because it is the next authorization check after the revocation.
The request may succeed because it authenticated before the revocation committed.
witness.observer: The operator sees either the requested project response or an authorization rejection.
